clean_room_scope: Phase-9 OpenCL conformance-readiness for a clean-room Ventus-based Celviz GPGPU IP proxy. This is CTS-oriented gap and local readiness evidence only: not Khronos CTS, not official OpenCL conformance, not a product ICD, not a production Linux kernel/DRM driver, not RTL structural coverage 100%, and not synthesis/STA/power/DFT/physical/silicon signoff.

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: OpenCL 3.0 profile/version/extensions/device-info tables and optional-feature queries are incomplete.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.next_executable_test: Generate device-info golden table and reject unsupported CL_DEVICE_* queries deterministically.
requirements.title: Platform and device enumeration/info

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: No stable ICD handles, reference counts, object ownership, or complete OpenCL error-code mapping.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.next_executable_test: Run host API lifecycle contract tests for context/queue/buffer/program/kernel/event create/release.
requirements.title: Core host object API lifecycle

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: The compiler accepts a first-stage subset only: one kernel per source and limited grammar/types/builtins.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.cts_orientation: compiler and kernel language CTS groups
requirements.next_executable_test: Extend parser/lowering case by case from vector add, GEMM, conv2d, image filter to CTS-shaped fixtures.
requirements.title: OpenCL C subset compilation

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: Math builtins, transcendental precision, denorm/rounding behavior, and conformance tolerances are not implemented.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.next_executable_test: Add integer/float builtin fixture families plus ULP/tolerance golden checks before enabling math CTS lanes.
requirements.title: Builtins, math, and numerical precision

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: Atomic operations are intentionally rejected in the current subset; memory-order scopes are not modeled.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.cts_orientation: atomics and memory model CTS groups
requirements.next_executable_test: Add local/global atomic op micro-tests behind an explicit feature flag, then map to scoreboard/LSU semantics.
requirements.title: Atomics and memory ordering

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: image*_t and sampler_t are rejected; no image object storage, formats, addressing, or filtering semantics.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.next_executable_test: Keep image/sampler negative tests green; only open implementation after memory object model supports images.
requirements.title: Images and samplers

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: Address spaces are parsed and traced but cache/scratchpad/coherency/local lifetime rules are not spec-complete.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.cts_orientation: memory object, buffer, local memory, and barrier CTS groups
requirements.next_executable_test: Add local memory lifetime/barrier tests and constant memory read-only violation tests.
requirements.title: Global/local/constant/private memory semantics

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: Proxy fence/event semantics exist; OpenCL event wait lists, callbacks, profiling, and out-of-order queues are incomplete.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.cts_orientation: event, queue, and synchronization CTS groups
requirements.next_executable_test: Add event dependency DAG tests with success/fault propagation and queue drain checks.
requirements.title: Events, fences, and queue ordering

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: Local subset rejects known unsupported features but does not yet map all failures to OpenCL error codes.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.next_executable_test: Create an OpenCL-style error code matrix for bad args, bad objects, bad geometry, and unsupported features.
requirements.title: Error and negative behavior

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: Current runtime is a CLI/proxy bridge, not a Khronos ICD vendor library.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.cts_orientation: ICD loader and CTS harness integration
requirements.next_executable_test: Build a mock libOpenCL vendor shim once host API contract tests are stable.
requirements.title: ICD/runtime integration

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: No production kernel DRM driver, GEM BO model, ioctl ABI, syncobj, scheduler, or hang recovery.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.cts_orientation: runtime/driver behavior under CTS process model
requirements.next_executable_test: Promote DRM-like submission proxy tests to ioctl-shaped fixtures before kernel-driver implementation.
requirements.title: Linux driver and OS integration

requirements.blocker_to_official_conformance: Functional/acceptance coverage is 100%, but structural RTL line/branch/toggle and signoff closure are not 100%.
requirements.claim_boundary: readiness/gap evidence only; not official OpenCL conformance
requirements.next_executable_test: Add directed/random/fault/stress RTL structural coverage gates and signoff input checks without redefining functional coverage.
requirements.title: RTL structural coverage and product signoff
